Initial: maintain cerebral perf & oxygenation - tx hypotension · hypoxemia · hypercarbia · hyperthermia · hyperglycemia · sz
Definitive: emergent decompression & surg evacuation (craniotomy) - minimally invasive (endovascular embolization · thrombolytic evacuation) in selected cases
Prompt tx → full recovery possible (underlying brain often unharmed)
